description: Claude Code Bedrock configuration - single source of truth

environment.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_DESCRIPTION: Most capable model yet - 1M context, high-res vision (up to 2576px / ~3.75MP), xhigh effort by default, stronger agentic reasoning and self-verification.
environment.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_DESCRIPTI: Best balance of speed and intelligence
environment.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_DESCRIPTIO: Fastest model for everyday tasks and subagents

notes.fast_model: Fast/background model defaults to Haiku 4.5 using ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL (Anthropic recommendation for cost & speed on subagents, exploration, etc.). ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL was removed because it is officially deprecated. See: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config
notes.1m_context: Opus 4.7 and Sonnet 4.6 have native 1M context windows in Amazon Bedrock; default model IDs stay suffix-free. The --1m-context flag records the user's context preference for Juggernaut-managed settings.
notes.effort: CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL sets the default effort for all models. Opus 4.7 defaults to xhigh per Anthropic recommendation. Override with --effort=low|medium|high|xhigh.
notes.subagent_model: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL controls the model for background subagents independently of ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL. Defaults to Haiku for cost efficiency.
notes.capabilities: SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES declares features Bedrock model IDs don't auto-detect (effort levels, thinking, etc.). See: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config
notes.source: Bedrock IDs and context windows verified against AWS Bedrock model cards: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-anthropic-claude-opus-4-7.html, https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-anthropic-claude-sonnet-4-6.html, https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-anthropic-claude-haiku-4-5.html. Claude Code model env vars verified against: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/model-config
